description: Phantom at the Muş monument site established in July 2025. No contributor has linked an identity so tail_number is deliberately blank.

Starfighter displayed alongside the Phantom at Muş. This airframe was moved here in July 2025 from an earlier position 1.5 km northwest at 38.73584 41.65259, which spottingmode records as vacated on 21 July 2025. The International F-104 Society lists CF-104 104796 at Muş and that is the probable identity, but no contributor has linked it, so tail_number is deliberately blank.
